issue.title: Register text message types for reflection

body:
> [@mkouba](https://github.com/mkouba) WDYT about [#47027](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/47027)?

@geoand I think that it's reasonable to register the return type of a `@OnTextMessage` for reflection, unless it's `void` or a custom codec is set. And we should also document this behavior ;-).

> And we should also document this behavior

I wouldn't document it to be honest as it's pretty much expected behavior for all our high level APIs

> > And we should also document this behavior
> 
> I wouldn't document it to be honest as it's pretty much expected behavior for all our high level APIs

Well, but it's best effort only. It would not work for complex hierarchies etc. Unless you switch from `ReflectiveClassBuildItem` to `ReflectiveClassBuildItem`. And even then I would doubt it would work for 100% use cases. Also it's an opportunity to instruct the users to register the types for reflection manually if something goes wrong...

> This does not happen when I specify custom codec (using `@OnTextMessage(codec = Mycodec.class)`)

@mocenas You can use the `@RegisterForReflection` annotation as the workaround - see also https://quarkus.io/guides/writing-native-applications-tips#registering-for-reflection.
